cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The required RED run showed that Logit, Probit, and Poisson family workflows completed without entering the shared survey variance engine, and the unsupported FPC workflow completed instead of being blocked.
impact: The initial implementation could have labelled naive model output as survey output and silently accepted an unsupported design field.
lesson: Instrument real family workflows before trusting capability declarations.

cause: Probit needed an explicit Binomial(Probit) link in the shared adapter, and Poisson exposure needed to travel through the same weighted refit and influence path to avoid a survey variance result paired with a mismatched point estimate.
impact: All supported GLM families use one survey adapter while unsupported links and invalid exposure inputs fail closed.
lesson: Keep model-specific link and offset details inside the shared estimator adapter, not in a second variance workflow.

cause: An unsupported devline-control subcommand and an unavailable interpreter path were used during an early status probe before the formal CLI command surface was checked.
impact: No repository or line state was changed; the probe delayed formal event recording until the supported append command was used.
lesson: Use the worktree interpreter and inspect the formal CLI command surface before appending line evidence.

cause: The existing survey report visibility tests reach run completion, but HTML report rendering is refused by the protected report helper because this direct test workflow has no admitted server receipt.
impact: Report HTML visibility and browser/report acceptance remain unverified for this line; model result artifacts and export visibility tests remain available.
lesson: Keep package-local survey evidence separate from the protected admission-receipt and browser acceptance boundary.

cause: A clean-process direct build_capabilities probe failed in the pre-existing StatisticalTestsStage and orchestrator circular import before reaching the survey capability projection; the scoped capability composition tests pass through their established harness.
impact: A standalone capability bootstrap smoke probe is NOT VERIFIED for this line; no Agent/HTTP or protected routing code was changed.
lesson: Report capability projection tests with their actual bootstrap context and keep unrelated import-cycle gates out of the survey implementation scope.

cause: The scoped survey design, composition, wiring, and v1.8.9 GLM family workflow suite completed successfully.
impact: 45 scoped survey tests passed, including real linearization and replicate workflow calls for Logit, Probit, and Poisson.
lesson: Require output-level instrumentation and metadata assertions for every supported survey family.

cause: The first core verification event source used preventability=not_applicable, which the formal event schema correctly rejected before append.
impact: The invalid event did not enter the chain; the corrected green gate event was appended after schema validation.
lesson: Validate formal event vocabulary before submitting gate evidence.

cause: The scoped backend and test tree compiled successfully and the working diff passed whitespace validation.
impact: compileall and git diff --check passed for the implementation state.
lesson: Keep syntax and diff hygiene as explicit gates alongside behavioral tests.

cause: The scoped P1 survey implementation, red-to-green tests, compile and diff gates, handoff, and explicit known-boundary evidence are complete on the requested development line.
impact: The branch is ready for review with core survey evidence complete; browser, report receipt, clean-process capability bootstrap, full gate, and release evidence remain explicitly NOT VERIFIED.
lesson: Close a scoped line only after implementation evidence and unverified external boundaries are both explicit.
